body:
rw [f.as_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a haf ↦ hasseDeriv_monomial_mul
    (fun j hj ↦ Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hf j hj ▸ monomial_le_degreeOf j haf)) _ _
abstract_premise: Any R-linear map T commuting with multiplication by all monomials occurring in f commutes with multiplication by f. Hasse needs substantive monomial normalization.
consequence: Finite sum/map_sum reduction abstracts, but it does not prove the monomial compatibility; no existing abstract R-linear map API supplies it for nonconstant f.
